title: FeatureCertificationLedgerEvent
description: One append-only event of the bottom-up feature-certification ledger. DESCRIPTIVE ONLY (CLAUDE.md §6.5): records certification outcomes; grants no runtime/production authority. The authority to promote a config/model stays in src/governance/promotion_manager.py / src/research/qualification.py — a PROMOTED event MUST attribute its authority there via promotion_authority. No event may set a runtime threshold/config value. Seeds/resolves via scripts/governance/feature_certification_state.py; mutation events appended by scripts/governance/feature_dag_certify.py. It is a LEAN certification-state layer that REFERENCES (not duplicates) feature_contract.schema.json and phase1_feature_identity_registry.

dependency_contract_hash.description: sha256 over {own formula_hash} + {promoted formula_hash of each direct dependency}

certification_evidence.description: pointer to the executable certification artifact

promotion_authority.description: REQUIRED on PROMOTED — must cite the code authority that grants promotion (never the ledger itself)

invalidates.description: REFERENCES to existing invalidation records (change_ids / FM-ids / artifact provenance) — never a fork of them

$comment: Per-event required extras (validated in Python by tests/test_feature_certification_ledger.py, stdlib-only): CERTIFIED requires formula_hash+dependency_contract_hash+certified_at+certification_evidence; PROMOTED requires formula_hash+dependency_contract_hash+promotion_authority; BLOCKED requires non-empty blocking_dependencies; INVALIDATED_STALE requires stale_reason+upstream_trigger; SUPERSEDED requires superseded_by. FORBIDDEN authority-creep keys (mirrors test_active_models_registry): no event may carry a numeric key matching promotion_requirements|min_delta or set a live *_threshold value.
